drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 84-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.74, creatinine 0.88, hemoglobin 13-13.2, platelets 313-319, sodium 139, wbc 7.6-8; vitals dbp 72-77, heart_rate 71-76, map 93-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 128-136, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.96-0.99, hemoglobin 13.1-13.3, platelets 320-322, sodium 139, wbc 7.6-8.2; vitals dbp 74-77, heart_rate 70-76, map 92-96, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 129-136, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 84-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
